description: Fall Guys Archipelago world driven by qualification/final results from the PC game log.

0.0.1.description:
Literally nobody asked for this, but I made a fall guy archipelago randomizer anyways! There are checks for qualifying in each individual traditional minigame! (Aside from bean hill zone, sweet thieves, and treat thieves due to availibility issues) 

ALSO there is toggleable death link. (When you get eliminated, it sends a death link, if you receive a death link the client prevents checks from sending on the current round you are on) 

You may wonder: What progression items are there?


Logic Crown: Allows you to send checks for the 2 Logic Minigames (Perfect Match and Sum Fruit)

Survivalist Crown: Allows you to send checks for the 10 survival minigames (Roll Out, Block Party, The Swiveller, etc.)

Points Crown: Allows you to send checks for the 12 points based minigames (Bubble Trouble, Ski Fall, Hoopsie Legends, etc.)

Teamwork Crown: Allows you to send checks for the 13 team based minigames (This is toggleable to turn off in yaml settings to exclude team minigames from pool entirely)

Final Round Ticket: The goal is to win a game after you have received enough of your final round tickets. Up to 50 can be in the pool, and up to 50 can be set as the end goal. 

The setup is super simple as this doesn't actually mod the game, just install the fall guys apworld and it will monitor the player log that updates as you play. I haven't tested this with the epic games launcher version as I play the steam version but it should work just fine so i encourage everyone to give it a shot!

0.0.2.description: Added the ability to send checks just for passively qualifying for rounds, capped by the "Progressive Qualify Cap" First 10% of qualify checks are sphere 0, there are 18 Progressive Qualify Cap items that increase the check pool by 5%. Minimum for this setting is 20 rounds, maximum is 1000 rounds for the really big fall guys people out there
